gates.rule: The 20-day average is above the 50-day average
The price is higher than it was 20 trading days ago
The price is not stretched: less than 15% above its 50-day average
The forecasting model gives better than 62% odds of a higher price
The portfolio does not already hold it
Enough cash is left over after the buy
Its sector stays under 40% of the portfolio
Altman Z-score of 1.81 or higher (not in the distress zone)
Beneish M-score of -1.78 or lower (no sign of manipulated earnings)
Price is no more than 25% above the estimate of fair value

rule: A company is a buy candidate only if it passes all 13. A gate with missing data counts as failed.
